alley_bins.title: Bins in the alley
alley_bins.speaker: protagonist
alley_bins.text: The bins are pulled a little into the alley, as if someone moved them to make room and never moved them back. One lid is warm from the sun that does not quite reach here.
alley_bins.repeat_text: The bins, still where they were left.

record.text: The bins in the alley have been moved to make room and left there.

alley_pipes.title: Pipes on the wall
alley_pipes.speaker: protagonist
alley_pipes.text: Pipes and cables run along the right-hand wall. One joint drips, darkening the same patch of concrete again and again.
alley_pipes.repeat_text: The pipes, the joint, the same dark patch.

record.text: A pipe joint in the alley drips onto the same patch of concrete.
